001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
012import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
013import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
014
015/**
016 *
017 * @author jimmy
018 */
019public class PropSetLowBound extends Propagator<Variable> {
020
021    private final SetVar set;
022    private final ISetDeltaMonitor setD;
023    private final IntVar bound;
024
025    public PropSetLowBound(SetVar set, IntVar bound) {
026        super(new Variable[]{set, bound}, PropagatorPriority.UNARY, false);
027        this.set = set;
028        this.setD = set.monitorDelta(this);
029        this.bound = bound;
030    }
031
032    private boolean isSetVar(int idx) {
033        return idx == 0;
034    }
035
036    private boolean isBoundVar(int idx) {
037        return idx == 1;
038    }
039
040    @Override
041    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
042        if (isSetVar(vIdx)) {
043            return SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER.getMask();
044        }
045        assert isBoundVar(vIdx);
046        return IntEventType.INCLOW.getMask() + IntEventType.instantiation();
047    }
048
049    private void boundEnv() throws ContradictionException {
050        int lb = bound.getLB();
051        int ub = bound.getUB();
052        ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
053        int i;
054        while (iter.hasNext()) {
055            i = iter.nextInt();
056            if (i < lb) {
057                set.remove(i, this);
058            } else {
059                if (i >= ub) {
060                    // The elements in the set's envelope are at least ub.
061                    setPassive();
062                }
063                break;
064            }
065        }
066    }
067
068    @Override
069    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
070        if (set.getLB().size() > 0) {
071            bound.updateUpperBound(set.getLB().min(), this);
072        }
073        boundEnv();
074        setD.startMonitoring();
075    }
076
077    @Override
078    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
079        if (isSetVar(idxVarInProp)) {
080            setD.forEach(ker -> bound.updateUpperBound(ker, this), SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
081        } else {
082            assert isBoundVar(idxVarInProp);
083            boundEnv();
084        }
085    }
086
087    @Override
088    public ESat isEntailed() {
089        if(!set.getLB().isEmpty() && set.getLB().min() < bound.getLB()) {
090            return ESat.FALSE;
091        }
092        if(!set.getUB().isEmpty() && set.getUB().min() < bound.getUB()) {
093            return ESat.UNDEFINED;
094        }
095        return ESat.TRUE;
096    }
097
098    @Override
099    public String toString() {
100        return set + ">>>=" + bound;
101    }
102}
